description_expanded: OverviewSANTA ROSA BEACH – Sea 9 at the Palms Gulf-Front Views | Pool + Beach Access | Sleeps 6 DESCRIPTION This completely renovated Gulf-front condo is located in the Palms of Seagrove along scenic 30A. Set on the second floor, it offers stunning views of emerald waters and white-sand beaches right from your private balcony. With fresh coastal furnishings, modern amenities, and a prime beachfront location, this condo is perfect for couples or small families looking for a relaxing beach escape. OUTDOOR LIVING & BEACH ACCESS Step onto your private balcony to catch ocean breezes and beautiful Gulf sunsets. Enjoy beach access via a private boardwalk and cool off in the community pool. An outdoor shower is available for rinsing off the salt and sand after a day at the beach. HOME FEATURES 1 bedroom | 2 bathroom | Hallway bunks + queen sleeper | Sleeps 6 Private Gulf-front balcony with Adirondack seating Newly renovated interior with all-new furniture and decor Fully equipped kitchen with LG appliances + Keurig K-Duo coffee maker Memory foam king bed + built-in hallway bunks with charging ports Queen sleeper sofa in living area 55” LG OLED Smart TV + Roku TV in bedroom Private washer and dryer Free parking for 1 vehicle 3 Beach Chairs DINING & ENTERTAINMENT Conveniently close to neighborhood restaurants, shops, parks, and entertainment WHY STAY HERE? Direct Gulf views from your balcony Newly renovated for a comfortable stay Private beach access + community pool Ideal for couples, small families, or snowbirds SLEEPING ACCOMMODATIONS 1 King bedroom Hallway twin bunks (memory foam) Queen sleeper sofa in living room Your perfect beachside retreat awaits in the heart of 30A.Show less
